gbm_population_evidence.quote: Documentation of a confirmed or suspected diagnosis of glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: Fe-MRI uses ferumoxytol as a contrast agent with MRI. Contrast agents are substances that are injected into the body and taken up by certain tissues, making the tissues easier to see in imaging scans.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The participant is scheduled to undergo standard of care surgical tumor resection and/or biopsy

flag.reason: Diagnostic imaging study before surgery/biopsy; record does not state whether newly diagnosed or recurrent tumours are enrolled.

role_evidence.quote: Fe-MRI uses ferumoxytol as a contrast agent with MRI.

agents.drug_class_hint: iron oxide nanoparticle (iron replacement; used here as MRI contrast agent)

flag.reason: Ferumoxytol is used as a diagnostic imaging contrast agent; no role category fits diagnostics exactly, coded as supportive (non-antitumour).

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour immune microenvironment markers (T-cell densities, CD4+/CD8+ T cells, M1/M2 tumour-associated macrophages) and systemic immune markers

source_quote.quote: Conduct more detailed correlation explorations focusing on relevant subpopulations, such as cluster of differentiation 4 (CD4+) versus ( cluster of differentiation 8 (CD8+) T cells and M1- versus M2-like tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs).

flag.reason: Immune cell markers are correlated with imaging measures; may be considered imaging validation endpoints rather than molecular biomarkers.

coder_notes: Diagnostic imaging trial (registered PHASE3). Only drug is ferumoxytol as MRI contrast agent; no antitumour intent, so no pharmacological candidate.
